title: Getting around: the interface
summary: The three zones of SquadHub — the icon bar, the module menu, and the content panel.

blocks.heading: The lay of the land
paragraphs: Every screen in SquadHub is built from the same three zones. Once you know them, you can find anything.

1 — Left icon bar: switch between modules (Home, Inbox, Tasks, Apps, Learning…). 2 — Module menu: the items inside the module you're in. 3 — Content panel: your main workspace, where everything opens. 4 — Home sections: your day at a glance.

blocks.caption: The three zones (plus your home sections)
blocks.alt: The app interface with the icon bar, module menu, content panel and home sections numbered 1 to 4
